tar-czf.text: Pack the directory `~/dokument` into the compressed archive `~/dokument.tar.gz`.
tar-czf.hint: Go to your home directory and use *create zipped verbose file*: `tar -czvf dokument.tar.gz dokument`.

tar-t.text: List the contents of `~/dokument.tar.gz` – without unpacking it.

tar-x.text: Create the directory `~/uppackat` and unpack `~/dokument.tar.gz` into it.
tar-x.hint: With `-C` you choose where tar unpacks: `tar -xzvf ~/dokument.tar.gz -C ~/uppackat`.

gzip.text: Copy `~/dokument/server.log` to your home directory and compress the copy with `gzip`, so that you get `~/server.log.gz`.

zcat.text: Show the lines containing `ERROR` in `~/server.log.gz` – without unpacking the file.
zcat.hint: `zcat` prints the contents of a .gz file. Pipe it into `grep`.

zip.text: Install the `zip` and `unzip` packages, and then pack `~/dokument` into `~/dokument.zip`.

hint.debian: Run `sudo apt update` and `sudo apt install zip unzip`. Don't forget `-r` for zip: `zip -r dokument.zip dokument`.
hint.arch: Install with `sudo pacman -S zip unzip`. Don't forget `-r` for zip: `zip -r dokument.zip dokument`.
hint.redhat: Install with `sudo dnf install zip unzip` and answer `y`. Don't forget `-r` for zip: `zip -r dokument.zip dokument`.

unzip.text: Unpack `~/dokument.zip` into the new directory `~/fran-zip` with `unzip`.
unzip.hint: `-d` chooses the directory and creates it if it's missing: `unzip ~/dokument.zip -d ~/fran-zip`.
